A plugin key: a tag item, written plugin:{plugin name}:TAG_{item name}, or an expression the plugin declares, written plugin:{plugin name}:EXP_{expression name}. As an itemName a tag item shows the plugin's value, or the item's default. As a condition key or an "&key" either reads what the plugin last pushed for the aircraft, else its default: a tag item's registered default, an expression's declared one. It reads empty while the plugin is not loaded and on a row that is no aircraft. A boolean expression reads "1" or "0".
Logical AND operator
Logical OR operator
Logical NOT operator: true when none of the listed conditions is true
Logical NOT EMPTY operator
Logical IS EMPTY operator
[]: the condition that always holds, as an absent one does where absence applies.

items.description: The time zone the times are in: an IANA id such as Europe/London, or UTC.

from.description: The first day a window may start: MMDD for a period every year, YYMMDD for a single one.

to.description: The last day a window may start, in the same form as from. A yearly period may run over the new year.

days.description: The weekdays a window may start on, 1 Monday to 7 Sunday, or 0 to run from start on the first day to end on the last.

end.description: HH:MM, up to 24:00. At or before start, the window ends on the following day.

anyOf.description: A time window, TopSky's activation schedule: ["within", zone, {from, to, days, start, end}]. A window that passes midnight stays until its end on the following day.

applyToFilterStates.description: Restricts this variant to aircraft in one of the listed display-filter states. An aircraft above the profile's upper altitude filter is kUpperFiltered, one below the lower filter is kLowerFiltered, and any other aircraft is kUnfiltered. OMITTING this key means unfiltered traffic only: filtered traffic is drawn solely by the variants that list its state and there is no fallback, so a system that says nothing about filtered traffic keeps hiding it.

plotImage.description: Sprite atlas frame name. Either this or plotShape is required.

plotShape.description: Vector symbol name from systems/shapes.json. Wins when plotImage is also present.

plotColor.description: Colour that the plotShape's inheriting elements take. Lets one shape serve every attention state. Takes every form a tag item color takes: an [r,g,b] or [r,g,b,a] array (a at most 1 is a fraction, above 1 is 0-255), a "=rule" or "&key" reference, or an array of references tried in order. The first entry that matches and reads as a colour wins; it is resolved per aircraft when the aircraft's data changes, never per frame.

steps.description: How many trail marks to draw. Replaces repeating historyTrailImages N times.

color.description: Colour the trail shape's inheriting elements take. Takes every form a tag item color takes: an [r,g,b] or [r,g,b,a] array (a at most 1 is a fraction, above 1 is 0-255), a "=rule" or "&key" reference, or an array of references tried in order. The first entry that matches and reads as a colour wins; it is resolved per aircraft when the aircraft's data changes, never per frame.

opacityRamp.description: Per-step opacity, oldest last. Shorter than steps repeats the final value.

historyTrailShape.description: Vector history trail. Wins over historyTrailImages. historyTrailsSkipSteps still applies.

anyOf.description: RGB color array [r,g,b]
RGBA color array [r,g,b,a]
RGBA color array [r,g,b,a] or [r,g,b] (0-255, and 0-1 for a)

primaryPlotColor.description: Colour of the raw video return; an aircraft it gives no colour draws none. Takes every form a tag item color takes: an [r,g,b] or [r,g,b,a] array (a at most 1 is a fraction, above 1 is 0-255), a "=rule" or "&key" reference, or an array of references tried in order. The first entry that matches and reads as a colour wins; it is resolved per aircraft when the aircraft's data changes, never per frame.

primaryHistoryTrailColor.description: Colours of the raw video history marks, newest first, one mark per colour. A list is an array whose FIRST entry is itself an array, and each entry takes every form primaryPlotColor takes, so [["=alertTrail", "=trail"], [0,219,219,150]] is two marks; an entry that gives an aircraft no colour leaves its mark undrawn. Anything else is ONE colour and one mark: [0,255,255], "=trail", or ["=alertTrail", "=trail"] (two references tried in order).

primaryHistoryTrailScale.description: The fraction of the aircraft's span and length a raw video history mark draws at, for the sprite and simulated returns alike. A history mark is the return the aircraft made at that past position (its own reroll, so each mark differs), in the trail colour for its age, one per primaryHistoryTrailColor entry, spaced by historyTrailsSkipSteps. Absent is 1, the previous behaviour. A value outside the range is clamped and logged once per variant.

primaryPlotStyle.description: How the raw video is drawn. sprite (also what absent means) is the atlas blob at the aircraft's footprint: the server's aircraft-dimensions span and length when it knows the type, else primaryPlotWingspan with vSMR's wake-category proportions. simulated synthesises the return on the GPU every frame from the same span and length, in the atlas's style: hard white cells on a grid sixteen cells long, a smeared fuselage with stub wings and a tail, a few dropouts and a stray speck, reshaped on the same reroll rules and drawn in the same primaryPlotColor; nothing is read from the atlas. polygon is vSMR's outline: twelve points from the aircraft's span, length and main gear width, taken from the server's aircraft-dimensions answer when it knows the type and otherwise from primaryPlotWingspan with vSMR's wake-category proportions; jittered per reroll like the blob, drawn in primaryPlotColor under the plot symbol. Only a variant with primaryPlotColor draws either.

primaryPlotWingspan.description: Span of the raw video blob in metres, used when the server does not know the aircraft type; a known type is drawn at its own span and length. The blob is drawn span wide and, with vSMR's wake-category proportions, length long, then turned onto the heading. Ground variants only.

primaryPlotWingspanByWakeCategory.description: Wingspan in metres per filed ICAO wake category, e.g. {"L":13,"M":34,"H":61,"J":80}. A category not listed, or an aircraft with no flight plan, falls back to primaryPlotWingspan.

primaryPlotSizeJitter.description: Metres of random size variation, plus or minus, redrawn with each reroll. 0 holds one size, so the blob changes shape but not extent.

primaryPlotRerollIntervalMs.description: Milliseconds between reshapes of a STATIONARY aircraft's blob. 0 reshapes only on movement, so traffic on stand holds one shape.

primaryPlotSynthesis.description: Shape of a primaryPlotStyle simulated return. Every key is optional and defaults to the NOVA 9000 look tuned against a Gatwick SMR picture: a lump filling about 0.58 of its own box, shoulders where the wings are, one dropout and one detached speck per return. Fractions are of the aircraft's own span or length, so one block reads the same on a Cessna and an A380. A value outside its range is clamped and logged once per variant; the block is ignored by the sprite and polygon styles.

cellsAlongLength.description: Grid cells nose to tail. The cell edge in pixels follows the aircraft's length on screen, never under one pixel; the atlas frames step on sixteen.

bodyFraction.description: Fuselage smear width as a fraction of the span. The atlas cross is 0.38; a real return is nearer half.

wingSpanFraction.description: Wing smear reach as a fraction of the span.

wingChordFraction.description: Wing smear depth along the aircraft as a fraction of the length.

wingPositionFromNose.description: Where the wing smear is centred, as a fraction of the length back from the nose.

tailFraction.description: Tailplane smear reach as a fraction of the span. 0 draws no tail.

swell.description: Fattens (positive) or thins (negative) the whole silhouette, in units of the half extent, so body and wings merge into one lump the way a real return does.

smear.description: Amplitude of the slow wobble along the boundary: the lumpiness of the edge.

grain.description: Amplitude of the per-cell noise on the boundary: the crumbliness of the edge.

dropoutsPerReturn.description: Interior cells knocked out, on average, per return. Spread over the cells the return is expected to fill, so a small return loses proportionally as many as a large one.

specksPerReturn.description: Detached cells lit one to two cells outside the boundary, on average, per return.

edge.description: cells decides every grid cell wholly on or off, as the primary-symbols atlas frames are. soft antialiases the boundary across a cell, as a real SMR video return is drawn; the noise stays per cell so the edge is still lumpy.

footprintScale.description: Multiplies the aircraft's span and length before the return is drawn. 1 is life size; the primary-symbols atlas blob the client drew before this style was about 0.75 of the span, so a package that found life size too big authors 0.75. History marks scale with it.

hoverShape.description: Vector symbol from systems/shapes.json drawn at the target position while the pointer is over the aircraft or its tag, as a grab affordance. The shape's own rotateWithHeading decides whether it turns with the aircraft.

hoverShapeColor.description: Colour the hover shape's inheriting elements take. Falls back to plotColor. Takes every form a tag item color takes: an [r,g,b] or [r,g,b,a] array (a at most 1 is a fraction, above 1 is 0-255), a "=rule" or "&key" reference, or an array of references tried in order. The first entry that matches and reads as a colour wins; it is resolved per aircraft when the aircraft's data changes, never per frame.

speedVectorColor.description: Colour of the speed vector. Takes every form a tag item color takes: an [r,g,b] or [r,g,b,a] array (a at most 1 is a fraction, above 1 is 0-255), a "=rule" or "&key" reference, or an array of references tried in order. The first entry that matches and reads as a colour wins; it is resolved per aircraft when the aircraft's data changes, never per frame.

Opens the release list: what the controller taking this flight next may do before the transfer of control point (turn, climb, descent, each optionally bounded by a level). Only for a flight you hold, and only on a system whose policy.json enables releases.
Asks whoever has this flight to put it on your frequency, as an OLDI ROF. No popup; a toast says whether it went.

Opens the next-sector list for a flight you hold whose exit is through a sector's floor or ceiling, where the exit level alone cannot say which sector takes it. Names the sector; the server re-sequences on it. On a lateral exit a toast says the geometry decides.

Opens the point-out list for a flight you hold: every other controller online. Sends an OLDI PNT to a controller who has advertised OLDI and the legacy #PC CCP:PT point-out to anyone else; neither has a reply, and the receiving screen shows it for the policy's hold time. Only on a system whose policy.json enables point-outs.

Toggles a quick-look pin on this aircraft for the radar view that was clicked: while pinned it is shown regardless of the view's upper and lower altitude filters (the GND, PRIM and VFR filters still apply). Click again to unpin. Per view, never saved.
Acknowledge the highest safety net alert on this aircraft: the repeat sound stops and alertAcknowledged reads 1, the colour stays. A change of kind or severity re-arms it. Available to an observer.
Silence safety net sounds for this session, or restore them. Reads back as alertsMuted, so the label can say it is silenced. Available to an observer.

Take this aircraft out of every client-side safety net until it is clicked again, or restore it: STCA, RAM, AIW and AFDAS all skip it, the emergency squawk net never does. The controller's per-aircraft twin of policy.json safetyNets.exclude; it never turns a net off for anyone else. Available to an observer.

Show or hide this aircraft's TCT legs for the session: both predicted paths of its earliest tactical conflict to the closest point, in mapstyle tctLeg colours, with the minimum and the time to it on the other aircraft's leg. While shown, the pair's speed vectors and route legs hide unless either has an STCA. Available to an observer.

Set the missed approach manual alert on this aircraft, or clear it when it is the one already set; one manual alert stands at a time, so this replaces another. Shared with every controller over the scratchpad and read back as manualAlert. Needs a track this controller may edit.

Set the inbound estimate manual alert on this aircraft, or clear it when it is the one already set; one manual alert stands at a time, so this replaces another. Shared with every controller over the scratchpad and read back as manualAlert. Needs a track this controller may edit.

Set the irregular manual alert on this aircraft, or clear it when it is the one already set; one manual alert stands at a time, so this replaces another. Shared with every controller over the scratchpad and read back as manualAlert. Needs a track this controller may edit.

Opens the runtime tag content toggles for the radar view that was clicked: one row per toggleGroup the view's system declares, ticked while shown. Saved in the view's profile. No ownership or connection gate.

rightClick.description: Action run when the symbol is right-clicked while this variant is the one drawn.

middleClick.description: Action run when the symbol is middle-clicked while this variant is the one drawn.

doubleClick.description: Action run when the symbol is double-clicked while this variant is the one drawn.
